scripts.db:init: cd apps/worker && wrangler d1 execute bookmarks-db --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: cd apps/worker && wrangler d1 execute bookmarks-db --remote --file=./schema.sql
scripts.package:chrome: npm run package:chromium && web-ext build --source-dir=apps/extension/.chromium-build --artifacts-dir=apps/extension/web-ext-artifacts --ignore-files config.example.js --filename "{name}-{version}-chrome.zip" --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:edge: npm run package:chromium && web-ext build --source-dir=apps/extension/.chromium-build --artifacts-dir=apps/extension/web-ext-artifacts --ignore-files config.example.js --filename "{name}-{version}-edge.zip" --overwrite-dest
